set.body:
Objective
Make benchmark_datasets a valid numerical oracle for beta recovery and HRF misspecification.

Required work
- Diagnose and fix the coefficient-scale mismatch under the declared correct HRF.
- Make every stored design matrix dimension agree with the 150-row response data; remove endpoint-induced 151-row grids.
- Reconcile the run_length schema with what the vignette documents and prints.
- Regenerate package benchmark data from the corrected generator.
- Compare correct and wrong HRFs with scale-sensitive metrics, not correlation alone.

Acceptance criteria
- Noiseless OLS with the correct HRF recovers every declared beta within a tight documented tolerance.
- All stored X matrices have nrow equal to nrow(Y_clean) and nrow(Y_noisy).
- No required metadata field prints blank.
- The wrong-HRF example is demonstrably worse on at least one predeclared scale-sensitive measure.
- Tests assert the oracle and dimension contracts, and the vignette renders the corrected evidence.
set.title: Restore benchmark-dataset ground-truth and design invariants
